description: Non-personal regional shipping operational rules. Do not populate without authorized verified seller operational evidence.

fieldRules.regionProvince: official administrative province name, source verified
fieldRules.regionLocality: official locality name or null for district-wide scope
fieldRules.sku: verified SKU such as D144/D156/D152/D026; use ALL only if operations confirms identical rule
fieldRules.orderCutoffLocalTime: HH:MM Asia/Seoul or null if unknown
fieldRules.shippingSurchargeRule: explicit KRW and applicable scope, not inferred from missing table rows
fieldRules.overlapPriorityRule: explicit seller-confirmed precedence for district vs locality surcharge
fieldRules.evidenceReference: nonpersonal document id or official seller URL

privacy: No recipient names, phone numbers, personal addresses, transaction IDs, individual delivery cases or customer data.
publicationGate: Unknown/missing operational fields must not be silently filled; candidate locality pages remain unpublished pending editorial and technical quality approval.
